10.1016/j.beproc.2004.08.007.expected: Few responses early in each interval; the response rate rises as the interval elapses, either gradually (a scallop) or after a break point.
10.1016/j.beproc.2004.08.007.notes: The paper's reinforcer is 20 s of a reflective mirror, and each interval is timed from the end of the previous reinforcer. contingency-py times FI from reinforcer onset, so a 20-s reinforcer would leave a 10-s interval after it; the reinforcer is shortened to 0.5 s so that the interval after each reinforcer stays close to 30 s.
